summary: 磁性的超快非热控制是自旋电子学的一个主要目标，然而，在中心对称材料中，对称性通常禁止通过电场进行直接控制。在这里， Lv、Meese和共同作者使用非线性Edelstein效应在范德华磁性半导体Cr2Ge2Te6中产生非平衡磁密度。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 26 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77965-4 Ultrafast non-thermal control of magnetism is a major goal of spintronics, however, in centrosymmetric materials, symmetry typically forbids direct control via electric fields. Here, Lv, Meese and coauthors use the non-linear Edelstein effect to create a non-equilibrium magnetic density in the van der Waals magnetic semiconductor Cr2Ge2Te6.

title: Achieving Heisenberg limit under noisy conditions with quantum Zeno dynamics and dynamical decoupling
title_zh: 通过量子Zeno动力学和动力学解耦在噪声条件下达到Heisenberg极限
summary: 量子芝诺动力学（ QZD ）和动态解耦（ DD ）是有效抑制量子系统噪声的有用工具。我们考虑了量子计量中何时可以抑制噪声和何时可以达到海森堡极限（ HL ）的问题，并证明了QZD和DD何时可用于实现这两个目标的必要和充分条件。我们进一步表明，即使在Hamiltonian-not-in-Lindblad-span （ HNLS ）条件失败时，这种情况仍然存在，允许QZD/DD恢复Heisenberg缩放，超出了通常基于HNLS的量子纠错（ QEC ）标准所证明的范围。
abstract: Quantum Zeno dynamics (QZD) and dynamical decoupling (DD) are useful tools that enable the effective suppression of noise in quantum systems. We consider the problem of when (i) noise can be suppressed and (ii) Heisenberg limit (HL) can be achieved in quantum metrology, and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for when QZD and DD are useful for achieving these two goals. We further show this condition can hold even when the Hamiltonian-not-in-Lindblad-span (HNLS) condition fails, allowing QZD/DD to recover Heisenberg scaling beyond what is certified by the usual HNLS-based quantum error correction (QEC) criterion. Finally, we demonstrate that the combination of both techniques can allow individually imperfect QZD and DD strategies to saturate HL.

title: Spin rephasing helps quantum memories store single-photon states longer for future networks
title_zh: 自旋重相可帮助量子存储器为未来网络存储更长的单光子状态
summary: 我们不断向彼此发送信息，通过连接的计算机和设备的巨大网络传输0和1。科学家们现在正试图将这种熟悉的互联网概念扩展到量子领域，寻找一种交换量子而不是经典信息的有效方式：量子比特而不是比特。动机不仅仅是科学上的好奇心。量子位可以是0、1或两者的任何叠加。它们也可能纠缠在一起，显示出一定程度的相关性，这是经典比特无法企及的。
abstract: We are continuously sending information to each other, transmitting zeros and ones through a giant network of connected computers and devices. Scientists are now trying to extend this familiar concept of the internet to the quantum realm, looking for an efficient way to exchange quantum rather than classical information: qubits instead of bits. The motivation is not just scientific curiosity. Qubits can be a 0, a 1 or any superposition of the two. They can also become entangled, showing a degree of correlation that is out of reach for classical bits.

title: AI-Assisted Link Quality Prediction for Weather-Aware Outdoor Terahertz Communications: Forecasting, Uncertainty, and Explainability Analysis
title_zh: 用于天气感知室外太赫兹通信的人工智能辅助链路质量预测：预测、不确定性和可解释性分析
summary: 室外太赫兹 (THz) 通信链路因降雨和大气衰减而遭受严重的、随时间变化的退化，但大多数先前的工作，包括我们早期的研究，都是在固定、离散的降雨率下评估这种损害，而不是将其作为动态过程进行预测。
abstract: Outdoor terahertz (THz) communication links suffer severe, time-varying degradation from rain and atmospheric attenuation, yet most prior work including our earlier study evaluates this impairment at fixed, discrete rain rates rather than forecasting it as a dynamic process. This paper proposes a real-weather driven THz channel and Link Quality Index (LQI) forecasting framework: a composite, application-relevant metric combining channel, reliability, and hard ware margins, computed by a physics-based simulator (ITU-R P.838-3 rain attenuation, ITU-R P.676 gaseous attenuation, and a modified Friis link bud get) driven by six years of hourly meteorological observations (51,888 records) from Sylhet , Bangladesh. We benchmark seven forecasting models and these are persistence, linear regression, random forest, XGBoost, GRU, LSTM, and a Transformer across four forecast horizons (1, 3, 6, and 12 hours) under a leak-free chronological 70/15/15 split, with hyperparameter sensitivity, multi-seed robust ness, Diebold–Mariano significance testing, Monte Carlo Dropout uncertainty calibration, SHAP explainability, a feature-group ablation, and a degradation conditioned stratified evaluation. Results show forecast skill of 21.5%–31.4% over persistence, well-calibrated but progressively overconfident uncertainty at longer horizons, and substantially higher error during rain and low-LQI conditions. To further validate the framework, we apply the identical pipeline to a second, climatically contrasting site (Rajshahi, Bangladesh) and find that the centralting site (Rajshahi, Bangladesh) and find that the central conclusions, including that aggregate metrics hide severe forecast failures under degraded conditions, hold consistently across both sites.
